Hi Asha —

Thanks again for running the pilot with us. I promised a concise recap and a small ask if QuickCart is comfortable. Below are the highlights from the last two weeks of the POC against the Shopping Search reranking workload (average query length ~27 tokens):

• Median end-to-end latency (99th pctl trimmed): 120ms -> 68ms (43% reduction)
• Cost per 1M tokens (inferred production mix): $210 -> $145 (31% reduction)
• Reranking recall@10 (measured vs. baseline): 0.72 -> 0.83 (net +0.11)

I've attached a one-pager that visualizes the delta and a short two-line quote draft for your convenience. We have a quick ask: would QuickCart be willing to provide a 1–2 sentence quote we can use in a brief case snippet, and/or join a 15-minute reference call with our marketing team?

If yes, here are two small options to make it easy:
1) Reply with a 1–2 line quote (we'll copy-edit for clarity).
2) Quick 15-min call next week — pick any of these slots: Thu 9/9 10:00-10:30am PT, Fri 9/10 9:30-10:00am PT, or Mon 9/13 11:00-11:30am PT. Or send a Calendly link and I'll book.

No pressure either way — we want to make this low-friction.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
